# dreamd — LLM-oriented index (llms.txt)
#
# Purpose: Curated link list for AI crawlers and tools that consume llms.txt.
# Audience: External LLMs discovering the project (not the in-repo AGENTS.md).
# Regenerate: Edit manually when top-level docs change; no automated script yet.
# Full text bundle: see llms-full.txt (concatenated excerpts).

# dreamd

> dreamd makes Claude Code, Cursor, and Cline remember the same things. Drop a
> `.agent/` folder in your repo, run `npx -y dreamd-mcp`, and every MCP-aware coding
> agent reads and writes the same memory — checked into git alongside your code.
>
> AGENTS.md is what you wrote down. dreamd is what your agent learned, across every tool.
>
> Where it fits: dreamd is the Linux-hosted proof, in the dreamOS charter (momo
> RFC-011, accepted 2026-09-26), of memory as plain files a person owns, with
> provenance. No trust label ships today; see ROADMAP.md, "Direction".
>
> Version: 1.0.0 (GitHub release `v1.0.0` and npm `dreamd-mcp` 1.0.0). Recall is
> lexical BM25 × salience — no vector or hybrid recall.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/README.md): Overview, install, and quick start
- [GUIDE.md](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/GUIDE.md): 20-minute linear tutorial — setup, learn, recall, dream cycle, daemon, memory branches, forget
- [SPEC.md](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/SPEC.md): `.agent/` folder layout, JSON schema, salience formula, dream-cycle contract
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/SKILL.md): Agent memory skill — MCP tool usage, `skill_action` naming, session patterns
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): Engineering invariants for the reference implementation
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Project context for coding agents working in this repo
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Dev setup and contribution guide
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Threat model and disclosure policy
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Version history
- [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): Shipped vs. not shipped, and direction
- [docs/README.md](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/docs/README.md): Full documentation index
- [docs/http-api.md](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/docs/http-api.md): HTTP API over the Unix socket (Windows: loopback TCP + bearer)
- [docs/configuration.md](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): TOML config keys and environment variables
- [docs/salience.md](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/docs/salience.md): Salience formula, factor by factor
- [docs/branching-guide.md](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/docs/branching-guide.md): `dreamd memory` branches, diff, bisect
- [docs/provenance.md](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/docs/provenance.md): Provenance ledger format; `dreamd doctor --provenance`
- [docs/observability.md](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/docs/observability.md): Recall citations (`explain=1`) and `dreamd salience-drift`

## Adapters

- [Claude Code](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/adapters/claude-code/.mcp.json.example): `.mcp.json` config for Claude Code
- [Cursor](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/adapters/cursor/README.md): MCP config and agent recall rule for Cursor
- [Cline](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/adapters/cline/README.md): MCP config for Cline
- [Aider](https://github.com/botzrDev/dreamd/blob/main/adapters/aider/README.md): Documentation-pattern adapter (no MCP) — append via the daemon's HTTP API

## Package

- [npm: dreamd-mcp](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dreamd-mcp): `npx -y dreamd-mcp` — downloads the right prebuilt binary (Linux x86_64, macOS x86_64/arm64), no Rust required
